settings.title: Settings
settings.note: Changes apply at once and are saved to settings.json in the tool folder.
settings.theme.hint: Ctrl+Shift+D switches between light and dark.
settings.workDir.hint: Each run keeps its capture, raw image and results here. Empty: work in the tool folder.
settings.exportDir.hint: A folder inside a Unity project cannot be chosen.
settings.captureMode.hint: Auto captures in the open editor when there is one, in batch mode when the project is closed. The tool never opens or closes an editor.
settings.batchTimeoutMin.hint: When it runs out the tool stops waiting; Unity is never ended.
settings.restoreTrackedFiles.hint: After a batch capture, .mat, .asset, .meta and ProjectSettings files Unity rewrote are backed up and restored.
settings.about.problem: The settings file cannot be read, so the defaults apply: {text}

empty.preview: Folders cannot be picked in the browser preview
